name: Tesseract Native Collision
description: Run an exact native Tesseract contact request and retain every contact.

inputParameters.name: planner
inputParameters.description: TesseractPlanner from Tesseract Planner. Only check_collision_native is used.

inputParameters.name: robot_cell_state
inputParameters.description: Exact RobotCellState supplying the native collision-check configuration.

inputParameters.name: request
inputParameters.description: Exact native ContactRequest controlling the contact query.

outputParameters.name: result
outputParameters.description: Exact TesseractCollisionResult wrapper retaining request, map, and contacts.

outputParameters.name: native_map
outputParameters.description: Exact native ContactResultMap from the contact manager.

outputParameters.name: native_contacts
outputParameters.description: Complete native ContactResultVector, including separated contacts.

outputParameters.name: colliding_contacts
outputParameters.description: Contacts at signed distance less than or equal to zero metres.

outputParameters.name: in_collision
outputParameters.description: True when at least one native contact is touching or penetrating.
